as_told.title: Kurt Russell sees Phoenix Lights while flying

plain: In 1997 the actor Kurt Russell is said to have seen the Phoenix Lights, a famous display of strange lights over Phoenix, Arizona, while he was flying his own plane. Jesse Michels mentions it in passing, saying Russell claimed the thing was so big "he could have landed his airplane on it." The UFO investigator James Fox tells it more fully in a later episode, giving Russell's account in Russell's own voice. In that version Russell is coming in to Phoenix and sees "a bank of lights, six lights in the shape of a triangle," passing right over the airport. Why it matters to the tellers is that a well-known pilot, not just people on the ground, says he saw the object up close from the air. The two versions differ on detail: one stresses the size, the other the six lights in a triangle.
